questions.question: What does the sin offering deal with?
Whose unintentional sin required one of the most serious offerings?
options: A young child or an unmarried woman
A poor laborer or a homeless beggar
The anointed priest or the whole congregation
A wandering foreigner or a hired servant
questions.answer: The anointed priest or the whole congregation

questions.question: The sin offering provided atonement so that the person would be forgiven.
The blood of the sin offering was sprinkled before the _____ in the sanctuary.
When atonement was made for the sin, the person would be _____.
